name: 363-walk-together
notes: #363 B7.c: a couple walks home together (staged by PairStage.WalkTogether; in the game PeopleView.Mates overlays the same pose on two walkers who last stood talking and leave the same way). Side by side 0.12 u apart, one speed, strides in step (shared stride phase), the inner hands joined and swinging together, a slight lean toward each other, and a turn to each other in turn (15 deg every 2 s, the lead first). Heading +x, the side walks at the lead's right hand.
